answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses for shadow work and spiritual practice**, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow***, **Charlie Morley’s *Embracing the Shadow* on Awake Academy**, and **ManTalks’ *Shadow Course*** because they appear more structured, in-depth, and explicitly oriented toward inner integration and transformation.[6][20][19]

A practical way to choose is by *style*:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** | Jungian foundation | It is described as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jung psychology series.[6][14] |
| **Embracing the Shadow** | Spiritual/transformational practice | It is presented as a transformative course focused on facing and integrating the shadow.[20] |
| **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** | Guided process | It offers an immersive 8-week guided process for fully facing and integrating the shadow.[19] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate Your Shadow Self** | Broad self-improvement | It emphasizes healing, integration, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |
| **Shadow Work and Workbook** | Exercises + meditation/prayer | It includes lessons, exercises, meditations, prayers, and practices for spiritual transformation.[15] |

If you prefer a **more psychological/Jungian route**, start with **Jung Platform**.[6][14] If you want a **more explicitly spiritual and practice-based experience**, **Awake Academy**, **ManTalks**, or the more practice-heavy Udemy options are better fits.[20][19][15]

A few useful caveats:
- **Udemy courses** vary more in depth and instructor quality, so they are often better as accessible introductions than as the most authoritative route.[3][15][16][17]
- **Insight Timer** offerings may be especially useful if you want a meditation-centered approach, such as *Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing and Growth* or *Shadow Work Toolkit For Deep Inner Healing*.[12][18]
- **Centre of Excellence** and **Courses for Success** appear more certificate-oriented and structured, which may appeal if you want a formalized self-study format.[4][11]

If you want, I can turn these into a **ranked top 5** based on your goal, such as **deep healing, spirituality, affordability, or beginner-friendliness**.
